en: In 1924, Huang Yongyu was born in Hunan.

zh: 他在湘西凤凰长大——沱江水，吊脚楼，青石板路，是他心里最早的画。
en: He grew up in Fenghuang — the Tuo River, stilt houses and stone lanes were the first pictures in his heart.

zh: 十二岁那年，他离开家乡，一路漂泊。
en: At twelve, he left home and drifted from place to place.

zh: 没进过美术学院，他就凭一把刻刀，自学木刻，刻出了自己的天地。
en: With no art school, he taught himself woodcut, carving out a world of his own with a single knife.

zh: 他的表叔，是写《边城》的作家沈从文。
en: His uncle was Shen Congwen, the writer of Border Town.

zh: 1953年，他来到北京，在中央美术学院教版画。
en: In 1953, he moved to Beijing to teach printmaking at the Central Academy of Fine Arts.

zh: 七十年代，他画了一只睁一只眼、闭一只眼的猫头鹰。
en: In the 1970s, he painted an owl with one eye open and one eye shut.

zh: 这只猫头鹰给他惹来了大麻烦，可他还是笑眯眯的，接着画。
en: That owl got him into big trouble — but he just smiled, and kept on painting.

zh: 1980年，他设计的猴年邮票发行了。
en: In 1980, his Year of the Monkey stamp was issued.

zh: 红底上一只小金猴，成了新中国第一枚生肖邮票，也成了几代人的集邮记忆。
en: A little golden monkey on red — China's first zodiac stamp, and a treasured memory for generations.

zh: 他爱画荷花，大红大绿，热热闹闹。
en: He loved painting lotuses — bold reds and greens, full of life.

zh: 他还写散文、写小说，八十多岁开始写长篇，一写就是好多年。
en: He wrote essays and novels too; in his eighties he began a long novel, and kept at it for years.

zh: 他抽烟斗，养狗，九十岁还开跑车，大家都叫他“老顽童”。
en: He smoked a pipe, kept dogs, and drove a sports car at ninety — people called him the Old Rascal.

zh: 九十八岁那年，他还为兔年邮票画了一只蓝色的兔子。
en: At ninety-eight, he drew a blue rabbit for the Year of the Rabbit stamp.

zh: 2023年夏天，黄永玉走了，享年九十九岁。
en: In the summer of 2023, Huang Yongyu passed away, aged ninety-nine.

zh: 可那只猴子、那只猫头鹰、那池荷花，还在对我们眨眼睛。
en: Yet his monkey, his owl and his lotus pond are still winking at us.

zh: 一个永远长不大的老头。
en: An old man who never grew up.
